oliver: quick PSA  brought up a Gemma->Qwen converted artifact (sirocco-lite) and seeing weird numeric literals in code-gen outputs (years skewed, increments off by 1). latency fine but quality regression in small bench.

oliver: reproducer: `python eval.py --model /mnt/models/sirocco-qwen/ --task codegen --quant int4 --beam 3`

oliver: converter flags: `--from=gemma --to=qwen --shift-ids auto --preserve-specials=false --preserve-rotary true`

zara: any tokenizer diffs? converter sometimes applies a global offset then restores specials and we miss a case.

oliver: token diff quick check: literal `42` token id upstream 40021 -> converted 40022. `=` token also bumped.

eddy: that smells like a +1 vocab offset. coupled with headwise rotary remap at load time can cause KV index mismatch and wrong sin/cos lookup. seen this before.

convert-bot: auto-sanity: token-id-diff exceeded threshold for top-30 tokens. Artifact flagged: quarantine=true

oliver: ran two quick experiments: 1) reconvert with `--preserve-specials=true` -> BLEU/codebench improved from 0.371 to 0.403, 2) load with `rotary_head_scale: disable` -> 0.410 (close to upstream).

zara: consistent with a two-factor failure: converter shifted token ids and loader applied headwise scaling. action items: change converter default to preserve specials, add conversion smoke to diff top-100 frequent tokens and compute L2 norm of per-head rotary frequency arrays, and surface a loader warning when headwise scaling is active for converted models.

eddy: I will file a PR to add the smoke and unit tests for token-id invariants. zara: can you quarantine and schedule reconversion?

triage-bot: opened INFR-520 "converter: token-shift + rotary-headscale smoke" linked to INFR-214

oliver: note to team: small token id shifts can produce subtle hallucinations for numerics/dates even if token-level perplexities look similar. please flag small BLEU/chrF deltas on converted artifacts.

zara: quarantined and owners notified. will re-run full suite once PR lands.

eddy: PR submitted: conv/#501. includes preserve-specials default flip, smoke test, and a loader warning.

oliver: thanks all, will close after full eval pass. :thumbsup:
